Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2 November 2026

VoterSlip Generator ("the App", "we", "us") is published by Aigentools, for Windows and Android. This policy explains what information we collect when you use the App — and just as importantly, what we deliberately do not collect.

What we do NOT collect

The App's core function — reading voter-list PDFs and Excel lists and generating voter slips — runs entirely on your own computer or phone. Voter names, EPIC numbers, addresses, photographs, and any other data contained in the files you process are never uploaded to our servers or any third party.

VoterSlip Generator is an offline processing tool. Because your files never reach us, we also do not know what slips you print, how many you distribute, or to whom. Those decisions, and their compliance with election law, are yours — see the Terms & Conditions.

Your role for voter data

For the voter data in the files you process, you decide why and how it is used, so under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 you are the data fiduciary. Aigentools provides the software and never receives that data. Keep the files you save secure, use them only for lawful election work, and delete them when you no longer need them.

What the App keeps on your device

Processing is local, which means the results are local too. While you work, the App keeps its own working copy of what it has read — the extracted voter records, any photographs contained in the roll, and the slips it generates — in storage belonging to the App on your computer or phone. None of it is uploaded.

  • It is stored encrypted. The working copy cannot be read by opening it from a file manager. This protects it from being browsed or copied off casually; it is not protection against someone who has full access to your device and your user account.
  • It is deleted after 48 hours. Most of it goes much sooner — on Windows, a run is removed as soon as you finish with it or move on; on Android, a copy of each run is kept so you can send it again. Nothing is kept beyond 48 hours; if the App is closed when that time passes, the clean-up happens the next time you open it.
  • Files you save or share are yours. When you save a spreadsheet or a slip PDF to a folder you choose, or share it to another app through your phone's share sheet, that copy is outside the App's control. The App never changes or deletes it, and the 48-hour limit does not apply to it.
  • You can erase everything now. On Windows, Settings → “Delete all app data”; on Android, Settings → “Delete everything stored here”. Either removes every working copy immediately.

What we do collect

To provide account access and wallet-based billing, we collect:

  • Account details — your email address, and the name and mobile number you give when you register. Used to sign you in (via Supabase Authentication) and to contact you about your account, a payment or a run.
  • Wallet balance and transaction history — records of top-ups, job charges, and refunds, tied to your account, used for billing and support.
  • Payment details — handled entirely by our payment processors. On Windows, top-ups go through Razorpay, which passes us only a payment confirmation and reference ID. On Android, top-ups go through Google Play Billing, which passes us only a purchase token. We never see or store your card, UPI ID, or bank details.
  • Your acceptance of the Terms — which version of the Terms & Conditions you accepted, when, and from which app (Windows or Android, and its version). We keep this as the record of your agreement.

The App also asks our server for prices, and, to read some PDF fonts, for small character-shape tables. Those requests identify font shapes by code; they never contain any voter's name, number or other text.

How we use this information

  • To authenticate you and maintain your session.
  • To calculate and deduct your wallet balance for jobs you run.
  • To return a charge to your wallet when a paid job fails to deliver.
  • To respond to support requests.
  • To show you updated Terms and record that you accepted them.

This website

This section covers voterslipgen.aigentools.in itself — the homepage and the voter guides — rather than the App.

  • The guides never ask for personal details. They explain official processes and link to the Election Commission's own websites; we do not run a voter lookup, and nothing you type on an official site reaches us.
  • Requests every visit makes. Pages load fonts from Google Fonts, and the homepage reads current prices from our backend and the latest App version from GitHub. Like any web request, these reveal your IP address and browser to those services; none of them sets a cookie for us. If you play the demo video, it loads from YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com).
  • Advertising and analytics only with your consent. We may use Google AdSense to show ads on guide pages and Google Analytics to count visits. When either is switched on, a banner asks for your choice first, and until you accept, Google's consent mode keeps advertising and analytics cookies off. If you refuse, any ads shown are not personalised to you.
  • Changing your mind. Your choice is stored in your own browser (local storage, under vsg-consent). Use the "Cookie settings" link at the bottom of any guide page to change it, or clear this site's data in your browser.

Third-party processors

  • Supabase — hosts our authentication system and wallet database.
  • Razorpay — processes payments (UPI/cards) in the Windows app and is PCI-DSS compliant.
  • Google Play — processes wallet top-ups made in the Android app.
  • Google — on this website only: fonts, and, if switched on and you consent, AdSense advertising and Analytics. Google's own use of that data is described at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.

Data retention

We retain your account, wallet transaction and Terms-acceptance records for as long as your account is active, and as required for accounting and tax record-keeping afterward. You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time (see Contact, below).

Voter data is not part of that: it never reaches us. What the App keeps on your own device is covered above — encrypted, and deleted automatically after 48 hours.

Your rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by emailing support.aigentools@gmail.com.

Children's privacy

The App is not directed at, or intended for use by, children under 18.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected here and in the App, with an updated "last updated" date, and where they change what you agreed to, the App will ask you to accept them before you continue.
